protocol: Paired refits of earlier non_grid configurations; no hyperparameter search. Full/complex/outliers-removed only. Retrospective revenue-based cohort filtering precedes splitting.
parameter_notes: Non-finite parameter values are omitted; estimator defaults apply (XGBoost missing=NaN).
temporal_boundary: Latest approximately 20 percent of rows; common year-month moved wholly into test.

shap.aggregation: Mean absolute attribution over the sampled held-out rows
